description: Same maths as Revunda's 1-star review cost calculator: estimated 1-star reviews per month by complaint theme (sector shares from the 29,785-review study), money exposure if you give a cost per 1-star, 5-star ratings that offset one 1-star, and 5-star ratings needed to reach a target rating. Sectors: parcels, telecom, taxi, energy, news, betting, travel, streaming, insurance, smarthome, banks, shopping, food, health, other.

cost_per_one_star.description: Optional: your own estimate of what one 1-star review costs you, any currency.

one_star_share_pct.description: Optional: your own % of reviews that are 1-star. If omitted, the sector average is used.

reviews_per_month.description: Total new reviews per month (all star ratings).

sector.description: Optional sector key for theme shares and the default 1-star share.

name: estimate_one_star_cost
title: Estimate 1-star reviews and the 5-star ratings needed
